# coef_map

```{r}
coef_map <- c(
  "(Intercept)"   = "Intercept",
  "s.logsize0"    = "Initial size",
  "s.TBF"         = "TBF",
  "s.TSF"         = "TSF",
  "s.P_RA"        = "Cumulative precipitation (annual)",
  "s.sq.P_RA"     = "Cumulative precipitation (annual)²",
  "s.P_RD"        = "Cumulative precipitation (driest month)",
  "s.P_RW"        = "Cumulative precipitation (wettest month)" ,
  "s.P_RH"        = "Cumulative precipitation (hottest month)",
  "s.T_LA"        = "mean temperature (annual)",
  "s.sq.T_LA"     = "mean temperature (annual)²",
  "s.T_LD"        = "mean temperature (driest month)",
  "s.T_LC"        = "min temperature (coldest month)",
  "s.T_LH"        = "max temperature (hottest month)",
  "s.sq.T_LH"     = "Max temperature (hottest month)²",
  "siteB2"        = "Site B2",
  "siteCH"        = "Site CH",
  "siteCM"        = "Site CM",
  "siteGSP-BI"    = "Site GSP-BI",
  "siteGSP-LI"    = "Site GSP-LI",
  "siteIA"        = "Site IA",
  "siteME"        = "Site ME",
  "s.P_RA:s.T_LA" = "Precipitation x temperature (annual)",
  "s.P_RH:s.T_LH" = "Precipitation x temperature (hottest month)"
)

```

"number of fruits" = crep_mod, "number of seedlings per fruit"=recruit_mod "variance in growth" = vargrowth_mod "growth"=growth_mod \# make coefficient plots for vital rate models \## survival

```{r}
sur_model_terms <- terms(survival_mod)

modelplot(list("probability of survival"=survival_mod,"probability of fruiting"=prep_mod, "growth"=growth_mod, "variance in growth" = vargrowth_mod, "number of fruits" = crep_mod,"number of seedlings per fruit"=recruit_mod), 
          coef_map = rev(coef_map), # rev() reverses list order
          coef_omit = "Intercept") + 
          # coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-30, 30)) +
          # color = ) + # use plus to add customizations like any ggplot object
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .75) # red 0 line


```

#coef table

```{r}


mods <- list(
  "Probability of survival" = survival_mod,
  "Growth" = growth_mod,
  "Probability of reproduction" = prep_mod,
  "Number of fruits" = crep_mod,
  "Variance in growth" = vargrowth_mod,
  "Recruit" = recruit_mod
)

modelsummary(
  mods,
  coef_map = coef_map,
  statistic = "std.error",
  stars = TRUE,
  fmt = 2,
  gof_omit = ".*", ## omit the summary statistics
  output = "Legacy effect/figures+tables/coef_table.png"
)

modelsummary::get_estimates(mods[[2]])
# crep_mod, vargrowth_mod, recruit_mod

summary(growth_mod)$coefficients

lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(growth_mod)
```
## coefficient table with texreg (recommended by AML)
```{r}
library(texreg)

texreg(list(survival_mod, growth_mod, prep_mod, crep_mod, vargrowth_mod, recruit_mod))


wordreg(
  list(survival_mod, growth_mod, prep_mod, crep_mod, vargrowth_mod, recruit_mod),
  file = "Legacy effect/figures+tables/coef_table.doc",
  # custom.model.names = c(
  #   "Survival",
  #   "Growth",
  #   "Reproduction",
  #   "Number of fruits",
  #   "Growth variance",
  #   "Recruitment"
  # ),
  digits = 2,
  stars = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05),
  single.row = FALSE
)

```


# TBF for each population

```{r}
FH <- read_csv("Legacy effect/processed-data/fire_histories_landscape.csv")
FH_upto2024 <- FH %>%
  filter(startyear>=2015 & startyear<2025)

FH_upto2024 %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise( meanTBF = mean(TBF), range = range(TBF))

range(TBF_long$startyear[which(TBF_long$site=="ME")])

```
